爱莎贝儿新品发布-140CM-M 粉肤 AHR030 小岛千鹤Kojima Chituru-魔女的禁忌魔法夜
月光如薄纱，轻轻笼罩在房间里。
紫色长发的她站在窗边，
紫黑色的连衣裙包裹着她娇小的身形，
裙摆缀着细碎的银星，随着她转动轻轻摇曳。
她回过头，可爱的脸蛋上带着一点羞怯又狡黠的笑，
眼睛亮晶晶的，像藏了整片星河的小魔女。
她慢慢走近，踮起脚尖，柔软的唇贴近耳边，轻声呢喃：“今晚……让我用魔法，把你变成只属于我的玩具好不好？”

Elsa Babe New Doll Release-140CM-M Pink AHR030 Kojima Chituru-The Witch's Forbidden Magical Night
Moonlight, like a thin veil, gently enveloped the room.
She stood by the window, her long purple hair flowing,
a dark purple dress draped over her petite figure,
the hem adorned with tiny silver stars, swaying gently as she turned.
She turned her head, a shy yet mischievous smile on her lovely face,
her eyes sparkling like those of a little witch holding a whole galaxy.
She slowly approached, tiptoed, her soft lips close to his ear, whispering: "Tonight... let me use magic to turn you into a toy that belongs only to me, okay?"
